name: Ospina (Colombia)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, green and white, the green charged with a row of black stars, the central one larger.
history: Municipal flag of Ospina, a municipality in the department of Nariño, Colombia; Colombian municipal flags are adopted by agreement (acuerdo) of the municipal council or by decree of the mayor.

features.role: row of stars with a larger star at the centre
